Test checks: PlanRealPackTest.run asserts steps == lastSlot-start+1, lastUsefulSlot in the last two weeks, and no budget exhaustion (lines 363-376). EndToEndRealPackTest.settledPlan asserts toSlot == lastSlot after every write.

items.requirement: Simulate consequences of every action: money, stats, affinity estimates, ranks, prerequisites, dates, Tartarus
items.evidence:
Kernel.java covers each item:
- meet (568-617): points and rank-ups with Persona and Charm multipliers.
- activity (684-704): cost, job pay tiers via payFor(shift), stat points.
- unlock (658-682): fees and steps.
- tower (706-728): visits per block and rescues.
- advance/rollover (731-755): dates, story ranks, rescue deadlines, automatic unlocks.
- prereqsMet (248).
PlanValidator.java:10-25 states that it is an independent accumulator sharing no code with Kernel, and that it checks predicted ranks and cash against its own recount. Every real-pack plan validates with no errors or warnings.
Caveat: Tartarus floor progress and tower cash are not forecast. Tower income is 0 by default, or the median of recorded returns (DESIGN_v3 §10.4; PlannerServiceReplanTest.towerIncomeIsTheMedianOfRecordedReturns passes). The handoff only asks for Tartarus visits, so this does not block the item.

items.requirement: Hard constraints: story/calendar locks, prerequisites, affordability, time-slot exclusivity
items.evidence:
Kernel enforces them:
- Kernel.legal returns 0 on locked slots (Kernel.java:263-292). Meetings come only from meetMask, which is built from per-day availability and invitations (Tables.buildMeetCell 254-263).
- unlockGroup checks earliest day, prerequisites, minGapDays and the summed fees (353-372).
- activityLegal checks cost plus cashBuffer and stat requirements (488-499).
- side() reserves the main action's fee before side steps (430-451).
- noteOpen checks the note price.
PlanValidator reports coverage, locked-slot actions, cash below zero, prerequisites, caps and rank jumps as errors. PlanValidatorTest passes 10/10 and every real-pack plan validates clean.
Re-run low-money probe (10/22, ¥0, 恶魔 MUST): devil=10, validate=[], minimum cashAfter 0.

items.requirement: User-defined Tartarus visit caps per story-unlocked stage
items.evidence:
The cap is enforced per block:
- Model.towerCap = profile.towerCapPerBlock (Model.java:65).
- Kernel.legal checks st.towerVisits[b] < m.towerCap (Kernel.java:282).
- Heuristics.java:1020 keeps room for a pending rescue.
- PlanValidator.java:397 reports 'Tartarus cap … exceeded in block'.
PlannerTest.towerCapOneStillLeavesRoomForTheRescue and towerCapZeroMeansNoVisitsAndTheMissingLinkIsLost pass.
But the cap is a single global integer, Profile.towerCapPerBlock (default 4), and the wanted visits are a single integer too, towerVisitsPerBlock (default 2) (Profile.java:48-51). SettingsPage.java:53-68 edits each with one stepper ('每个区块最多去几次'), and r2_13_tower.png says '上限 4 次，可在「规划设置」里修改'.
The v2 source in P3R_Planner_Handoff_20261013.zip stored constraints.visit_caps keyed by STAGE.
items.gap: There is no per-stage (per-block) cap. Each block needs its own user-editable cap (and wanted-visit count), stored in the Profile, enforced by Kernel.legal and Heuristics, checked by PlanValidator, and shown in settings or on the tower page.

items.requirement: Maximise explicit goals in priority order
items.evidence:
Working cases:
- MUST beats WANT: PlannerTest.mustBeatsWantWhenTheyCompete passes (synthetic year).
- Re-run probe at the 10/22 mid-game state: MUST 力量 + WANT 正义 gives 力量 10, 正义 8.
- Single MUST or WANT 力量, 恋爱 or 正义 each reach 10.
- 皇帝 MUST reaches MAX on 6/29 on the real pack.
Failing cases (re-run with scratchpad/recheck_oo/src/Probe.java, mode 'two'):
- MUST#1 力量 + MUST#2 正义 with 其余社群 on (the default) gives 力量 9, 正义 10. The plan note says '力量：时间不够，预计停在 RANK 9'.
- The same goals with 其余社群 off give 力量 10, 正义 10, so both are feasible.
- A 30 s budget with K=8 still gives 力量 9.
- MUST#1 恋爱 + MUST#2 正义 gives 恋爱 9, 正义 10 at default options. With K=8 it reaches 恋爱 10, which confirms this is a search limit, not infeasibility.
Cause: goals are scalarised as wGoal = 100000 − 100·order (Heuristics.java:265), so order only breaks near-ties, and FORTIFY = 3 is fixed (Planner.java:91). No engine test sets two goals in the same tier and checks their order (RulesFixtures.must is only ever called with one link).
The '时间不够' note contradicts the handoff rule against presenting a search failure as infeasibility.
items.gap: Higher-priority goals must be secured first: plan goals lexicographically or in strict priority order before secondary links, or raise the order weight. Add an engine test where two MUST goals compete and the order decides the outcome. Stop labelling a reachable goal '时间不够'; distinguish search limits from real infeasibility.

items.requirement: With remaining time maximise OTHER links; an easy goal must not leave the calendar arbitrary or empty
items.evidence:
其余社群 is on by default (Profile.java:31). A non-goal RANK is worth W_OTHER=300, plus 6×W_OTHER for MAX (Heuristics.java:59-60, 256, 274).
Results:
- 皇帝 MUST plan: 458 useful, 1 free, 21/22 MAX. The test asserts others ≥ 19 (PlanRealPackTest:100).
- GOALS-Persona plan with 3 goals: 21/22.
- Mid-game single MUST 力量 (re-run probe): 169 useful, 0 free, 12 maxed.
Planner.daytimeWaste and WASTE_MARGIN discourage spending daytime off-link (Planner.java:55-57, 199-226).
With 其余社群 explicitly off, the re-run probe gives 56 free slots and 209 jobs, which is the expected opt-out behaviour.

items.requirement: Prefer less fragile routes and sensible resource buffers
items.evidence:
Buffers that exist:
- The goal buffer (Profile.goalBuffer, on by default) adds one ordinary meeting of margin per point-gated goal rank (Kernel.need and bufferApplies, 202-210).
- The objective rewards earlier goal completion (Heuristics.objective, EARLY_PER_SLOT term), which gives goals implicit slack.
- Job pay uses the minimum tier, and tower income is 0 by default.
- Re-run replay of the 皇帝 MUST plan: 皇帝 still reaches 10 at ordinaryGain 9, 8 and 7, and 9 at gain 5.
Where fragility remains (re-run probe, mode 'fragile'):
- Replaying the 22/22 no-Persona plan with gain 9 instead of 10 gives only 14/22 MAX (13 at gain 7). Non-goal links have no slack.
- Manual links reach MAX close to the end: lovers 1/25, priestess 1/18, aeon 1/30. Aeon only opens 1/8, so it is late by necessity. Correction to the earlier evidence: judgement (1/29) is a story link, so it is not a fragility case.
- Profile.cashBuffer defaults to 0 (Profile.java:53). Unlock fees are explicitly 'mandatory (no cash buffer)' (Kernel.java:351).
- Plans run cash down to ¥220 at the end (mid-game) and ¥910 on 12/1 (皇帝 MUST).
- PlanRealPackTest asserts cash on 12/1 ≤ ¥60,000 (MODEST_CASH), which discourages holding cash.
Replanning after a deviation is the only mitigation for non-goal links.
items.gap: Add a robustness preference for non-goal links planned to MAX: slack meetings, or a penalty when a MAX depends on the last available opportunity. Use a non-zero default cash buffer, or reserve cash ahead of mandatory unlock fees.

items.requirement: Do not force romance just to advance an optional objective
items.evidence:
The engine needs no romance: no link in the pack has eventGainRomance, Profile.route defaults to UNDECIDED, and route is only read in Model.java:84 and PlanValidator.java:651. Dec 24 invitations are declined by default (DESIGN §10.5).
The '参考回答' line still recommends romance answers for links the player never chose to romance. Dialogue.WARNING (Dialogue.java:28) drops the guide's route notes.
Pack dialogue checked with Python:
- 正义 RANK 5 shows '随便问吧（1） / 产生恋爱感情了（1） / 随时欢迎千寻找我倾诉（1） / 握住她的手（1）'. The notes '第二次选择“产生恋爱感情了（1）”会进入恋爱线；选第二项不会进入' and '…关系会破裂' are removed silently (asserted in ReviewFixesTest.copy5_answerLineShowsOnlyCleanGuideAnswers, which passes).
- 女教皇 RANK 9 ('我喜欢风花（1），恋人线') and 永劫 RANK 8 ('是恋情（1，恋人线）') at least keep the 恋人线 label, but offer no friend alternative.
No ui/ class reads or writes Profile.route, so there is no route choice anywhere.
items.gap: Add a per-link 朋友/恋人 choice for romanceable links, defaulting to 朋友. Show friend-route answers, or keep the guide's route warning, instead of recommending romance answers for links that are only being maxed as 其余社群 or as optional goals.

items.requirement: Suitable offline algorithm; budget exhaustion, coverage and useful-day investigation; independent replay validation
items.evidence:
Design: the v2 beam (width 48, 60,000 transitions) was investigated and replaced. DESIGN_v3 §1 records its failure: 1 useful action from June to January, 6 links out of budget by 7/21. The new search screens a 16-tuning portfolio with the base policy, then runs a fortified rollout on the best 3 (Planner.java:72-160).
Results: in every real-pack run budgetExhausted is false (asserted). Runtime is 166–728 ms on the desktop JVM and 892 ms through the service in my run. Useful actions range from 169 to 458, with full coverage to 1/31.
Validation: PlanValidator is an independent replay (header, lines 10-25). PlannerTest.tinyTimeBudgetStillGivesACompleteValidPlan and cancellationStopsSearchingButKeepsThePlanComplete pass.
Caveats (corrected):
- Extra time budget goes unused. Plans finish in about 200–360 ms even with a 30 s budget.
- Raising K to 8 changes outcomes non-monotonically: 恋爱 MUST#1 rises from 9 to 10, while WANT 正义 next to MUST 恋爱 drops from 10 to 9.
- No on-device planning time is recorded anywhere in qa_out. Only desktop timings exist, against an on-device budget of 2.5 s (Wiring.java:28), and DESIGN §5.4 still says 4 s.
- The '时间不够' mislabelling of a search limit is covered under the priority item.

items.requirement: F1. Never require hidden numbers: no raw affinity or social-stat points are asked for
items.evidence: Verified. StateSteps.pagesFor (StateSteps.java:52-78) builds only visible-value pages: GOALS, PERSONA, DATE, CASH, STATS, LINKS, UNLOCK, EPISODES, TOWER, CONFIRM. The RANK grid holds 0..10 or '?' (StateDraft.UNKNOWN, RankPad.java:121). StateDraft.build() derives hidden values: a changed rank sets pts=0, ready=false (StateDraft.java:459-461), and a changed Lv sets statPts to thresholds[lv] (StateDraft.java:438-443). Screenshots exist: qa_out/v3/ui/state_onboarding_stats.png, state_rankpad.png, state_onboarding_links.png. I re-ran the tests and UiLogicTest passed 23/23, which includes untouchedDraftKeepsHiddenEstimates and changedValuesResetOnlyTheirOwnEstimates. Log: scratchpad/run1.log; XML in scratchpad/results1.

items.requirement: F2. Start from conservative values compatible with visible ranks and confirmed observations
items.evidence: Verified. StateDraft.newGame sets cash=0, cashExact=false and stats at the Lv1 threshold (StateDraft.java:124-133). Changed ranks start at pts=0 and changed Lv at the lower threshold (StateDraft.java:438-465). Forecast.visibleAt projects only visible values: stats go to thresholds[lv] (Forecast.java:35-39), and setRank zeroes pts only on a rank increase, so forecast ordinary-meeting points are never carried (Forecast.java:116-122). After a rank-up only the scene points carry over, floored (Kernel.java:183-197, 584-587). REPORT.md says those are the lower of aqiu's optimum and the normalised model. UiLogicTest.forecastProjectsVisibleValuesOnly passed in my run.
items.gap: Minor. Choosing 不确定 for cash in 修改进度/同步现状 keeps the prefill figure, i.e. the last record or, after 「是」, the forecast cash (StateDraft.java:431-433). The engine never reads cashExact for affordability; the only cashExact uses are bookkeeping (Simulator.java:123/207, Kernel.java:691/711). A stale balance is therefore not treated conservatively. Scene points assume best answers by default (Profile.answers=BEST). This is disclosed as best_answers but is not the most conservative choice.

items.requirement: F3. Do not silently assume matching-Persona or Charm bonuses
items.evidence: Verified. Profile.personaMode defaults to NONE (Profile.java:38). Onboarding has a PERSONA page with three choices (StateSteps.java:56-58; StateWizardTest.personaPageOffersThreeChoices passed; state_onboarding_persona.png exists). Charm ×1.51 applies only once the forecast stat reaches its cap (Kernel.charmBonusActive, Kernel.java:173-176). Each meeting that uses it is tagged A_CHARM (Kernel.java:572), and DayDetailSheet shows it under 这一步用到的估计 (Assumptions.java:24; DayDetailSheet.java:85-92). 规划说明 lists it (Assumptions.java:90-92) and 规划设置 has a toggle (SettingsPage.java:38-40). The source value exists: rules/sources/aqiu_gamedata/DT_GeneralCoefficient.tsv:5 'CMM_POINTBONUS_CHARM 1.51'. Pack policy multConf=game_data.
items.gap: charmBonus defaults to true (Profile.java:44) and onboarding never asks about it. It is disclosed, so not silent, but it is opt-out rather than opt-in.

items.requirement: F4. Keep observed state, forecast state and evidence/model assumptions rigorously separate
items.evidence: Verified. DESIGN_v3.md:244-248 states that observed state is the checkpoint plus replayed non-voided events and that forecasts never write into checkpoints or events. SimState is documented as copied by the planner and never written back (SimState.java:10-14). Pack policy carries ordinaryGainConf=estimate and multConf=game_data with src ids (assets/p3r/p3r_rules.json policy). Step assumptions are rendered under 这一步用到的估计 (DayDetailSheet.java:85-92; seen in qa_out/v3/ui/home_detail_current.png). The wizard tags forecast values 预计 (StateSteps.java:542-552), and the diff page says '带「预计」的数值请对照游戏核对，保存就算确认' (StateSteps.java:756-757). In my run PlannerTest passed 23/23, including observedStateIsNotMutated, and OutcomeTest passed 14/14, including inputStateIsNeverMutated.

items.requirement: F5. Forecasts propagate forward without pretending to be saved progress
items.evidence: Verified. Forecast.visibleAt works on a copy (Forecast.java:19-48) and is used only to prefill 同步现状「是」 (StateDraft.prefill, StateDraft.java:148-160). Saving needs the CONFIRM diff page and its 预计 notice (StateSteps.java:745-757). Forecast meeting points are dropped (Forecast.java:116-122). Both UiLogicTest.syncYesWithUnknownRankKeepsTheRecord and StateWizardTest.syncAnsweredYesPrefillsForecastAndShowsDiff passed in my run. The plan to Jan 31 is confirmed by realpack.log (below).

items.requirement: F6. Use evidence-backed recurring availability with known exceptions; a missing annotation is not proof of unavailability; weekday rules never override forced story events or an accepted invitation
items.evidence: REPORT.md: 'A slot without a lock is free (handoff: absence of an annotation is not proof of unavailability)'. avail is aqiu cells minus locks and explicit exceptions. RulesPackFactsTest passed 41/41, including meetingsNeverFallOnLockedSlots, april22DaytimeIsTheForcedMagicianIntroduction, fullMoonOperationsLockTheWholeDay and christmasEveIsFreeByDefault. SimulatorTest.holidayInvitationIsADaytimeMeeting also passed. Pack entry 01-21 has dayLock=reserved and conf=estimate.
items.gap: An accepted invitation that the pack assumes was declined cannot be entered ahead of time. The 12-24 pack entry has dayLock=null, eveLock=null and noteZh '平安夜：默认按婉拒所有邀约来安排'. 规划说明 says '12月24日默认不接受邀约' (Assumptions.java:106). No Profile or SimState field marks Dec 24 as taken: Profile.route only switches event gains (Model.java:84-85). A player who accepted a date is still shown a routine action there and must skip it afterwards. This is the weekday-rule-over-accepted-invitation case the handoff names (handoff line 74).

items.requirement: F7. Use a conservative ordinary-meeting model with buffers, do not label a safety margin a guarantee, and keep the +10 claim unverified
items.evidence: Verified. Pack policy has ordinaryGain=10 and ordinaryGainConf=estimate. Its pack note reads '只有一份实况记录提到，未经验证'. rules/p3r/ordinary_affinity_numeric_followup.json:5 has status 'single_source_numeric_candidate_not_independently_verified'. In-app text (Assumptions.java:19): '…这是估计值，没有官方数据'. The goal buffer adds one ordinary gain to need (DESIGN_v3.md:154) and is described as '以防估计偏高' (Assumptions.java:94; SettingsPage.java:41-43), never as a guarantee. '一定能升到' is emitted only when fx.certain, i.e. a ready cue or a zero threshold (Labels.java:244; Kernel.java:591). The ready flag is set only from player-reported outcomes (Simulator.java:201). SimulatorTest.goalBufferAppliesOnlyToGoalsAndOnlyWhenThresholdPositive passed in my run.
items.gap: Minor. The +10 is used at its single-source central value, not reduced, and the buffer covers goal links only. Yet 规划说明 says '一律按保守的估计值计算' and '每一步在游戏里都做得到' (Assumptions.java:76, 107), which overstates certainty.

items.requirement: F9. No warning badges on every widget line; important assumptions are explained in app detail
items.evidence: Verified. In qa_out/v3/widget/real/mid-social-422/424/512/569-320x200-sdk31.png there are no estimate badges. Estimated and certain steps differ only in plain text ('这次见面一定能升到 RANK 3' / '好感还不够升级，先多见面几次'). The ❗ line on those renders is a Persona reminder, not an estimate warning. items.requirement: F10. Replan when actual results differ or the player changes goals or state

items.gap: (1) In onboarding, a RANK of '?' is saved as rank 0 (未解锁), because build() copies base.rank, which is 0 for a new game (StateDraft.java:447-454).
